import json,re,subprocess,collections,concurrent.futures
with open('packet.json') as f:
    packet=json.load(f)
items=packet['items']
assert len(items)==140
assert len({x['id'] for x in items})==140
verified=\"\"\"MATCH (r:Resolution {resolutionScope: 'document_disposition'})-[:HAS_DISPOSITION]->(d:DecisionDisposition {evidenceStatus: 'source_verified'})-[:DISPOSITION_TARGET]->(t)
MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting {workingGroup: 'RAN3'})
WHERE d.assessmentMethod CONTAINS '\\\"scope\\\": \\\"whole_target\\\"'\"\"\"
expressions={'document':'t.tdocNumber','final_document':'t.tdocNumber','disposition':'d.dispositionCode','wg_meeting':'m.meetingNumber','cr_pack':'p.crPackId','tsg_meeting':'p.tsgMeeting','clause':'s.sectionNumber'}
records=[]
shape_counts=collections.Counter()
for item in items:
    question=item['question']
    if question.startswith('Which Rel-'):
        release,clause,spec=re.search(r'Which Rel-(\\d+).*?clause (\\S+) of TS (\\S+)',question).groups()
        shape='release_clause'
        body=f\"MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:TARGET_RELEASE]->(:Release {{releaseName: 'Rel-{release}'}})\\nMATCH (t)-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {{specNumber: '{spec}', sectionNumber: '{clause}'}})\\nMATCH (t)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"+verified
    elif question.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack'):
        pack=re.search(r'RP-\\d+',question).group()
        shape='pack_contents'
        body=f\"MATCH (t:Tdoc)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack {{crPackId: '{pack}'}})\\n\"+verified
    elif question.startswith('RAN3 recorded'):
        doc=re.search(r'R3-\\d+',question).group()
        shape='revision'
        body=f\"MATCH (s:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:REVISED_TO*1..]->(t:Tdoc)\\nMATCH (t)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"+verified
    else:
        doc,cr,spec=re.search(r'(R3-\\d+) \\(CR (\\d+) to TS ([\\d.]+)\\)',question).groups()
        if question.startswith('Trace change request'):
            shape='trace'
            body=f\"MATCH (t:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:MODIFIES_SECTION]->(s:Section {{specNumber: '{spec}'}})\\nMATCH (t)-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"+verified
        elif question.startswith('Change request'):
            shape='decision'
            body=f\"MATCH (t:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\\n\"+verified
        elif question.startswith('In which TSG RAN CR pack'):
            shape='direct_pack'
            body=f\"MATCH (t:Tdoc {{tdocNumber: '{doc}'}})-[:BELONGS_TO_CR_PACK]->(p:CRPack)\"
        else:
            raise ValueError(question)
    query=body+'\\nRETURN DISTINCT '+', '.join(expressions[field]+' AS '+field for field in item['fields'])
    records.append({'id':item['id'],'cypher':query})
    shape_counts[shape]+=1

def check(pair):
    item,record=pair
    result=subprocess.run(['python3','query_graph.py',record['cypher']],capture_output=True,text=True)
    if result.returncode:
        raise RuntimeError(item['id']+': '+result.stderr+' '+result.stdout)
    data=json.loads(result.stdout)
    if data.get('columns')"'!=item['"'fields'] or 'rows' not in data or data.get('error') or data.get('truncated'):
        raise RuntimeError(item['id']+': '+json.dumps(data))
    return {'id':item['id'],'row_count':data.get('rowCount',len(data['rows']))}

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=4) as executor:
    checked=list(executor.map(check,zip(items,records)))
normalized={re.sub(r\"'(?:["'^'"']|'')*'\",\"'VALUE'\",record['cypher']) for record in records}
assert len(normalized)==6
serialized=''.join(json.dumps(record,ensure_ascii=False)+'\\n' for record in records)
assert len(serialized.splitlines())==140
assert all(set(json.loads(line))=={'id','cypher'} for line in serialized.splitlines())
with open('queries.jsonl','w') as f:
    f.write(serialized)
print(json.dumps({'queries_written':len(records),'distinct_query_shapes':len(normalized),'shape_counts':dict(shape_counts),'queries_tested':len(checked),'empty_results':sum(x['row_count']==0 for x in checked),'errors':0,'truncated_results':0,'wording_uncertainties':[]},ensure_ascii=False))
PY"
